newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand cracks down on government travel perks.
newsitem.headline: Thailand cracks down on government travel perks.

text.p: Thailand on Tuesday cracked down on travel perks enjoyed by its jet-setting government officials.
The cabinet issued an order suspending all unnecessary government foreign travel in a bid to save money, an official said.

"The budget bureau has noticed that government officials at all levels take the opportunity to make training or seminar trips abroad after they discover they have some left over money from their budgets," government spokesman Varathep Rattanakor told a news conference after the weekly cabinet meeting.
"So the cabinet has approved the budget bureau proposal to suspend all unnecessary foreign trips for the time being."
Travel by government officials, including politicians making frequent trips to foreign countries, has sparked criticism from Thai taxpayers who are suffering from a sharp downturn in the economy.

"They claim to travel for seminars or training but in many cases these people do not understand the language at all, so how can they claim to be at a seminar or doing training?" a woman complained over call-in radio.
